a4DeathStacks.label: Death's Crossing stacks
a4DeathStacks.reason: She gains a stack when Hydro or other Cryo party members hit enemies, so the stacks depend on the team.

burstVoidAbsorb.label: Void Rifts absorbed
burstVoidAbsorb.reason: Void Rifts come from Cryo reactions the party triggers, so how many she absorbs depends on the team.

c2AfterBurst.label: Constellation 2 ATK after Havoc: Extinction
c2AfterBurst.reason: After her Burst she attacks in Seven-Phase Flash for the 12.5 seconds the bonus lasts; her ordinary Normal Attacks and the Burst itself do not get it, and the planner counts it for the Seven-Phase attacks alone.
